description: This file defines the AWS SDK client class for Amazon Q Connect, including method annotations for various API operations related to the service.

classes.name: QConnectClient
classes.description: This class extends AwsClient and provides methods to interact with the Amazon Q Connect service API.

methods.name: activateMessageTemplate
methods.description: Activates a message template in Amazon Q Connect.

methods.name: createAIAgent
methods.description: Creates an AI agent in Amazon Q Connect.

methods.name: createAIAgentVersion
methods.description: Creates a new version of an AI agent.

methods.name: createAIGuardrail
methods.description: Creates a guardrail in Amazon Q Connect.

methods.name: createAIGuardrailVersion
methods.description: Creates a new version of a guardrail.

methods.name: createAIPromptVersion
methods.description: Creates a new version of an AI prompt.

methods.name: createAssistantAssociation
methods.description: Associates an assistant with other resources.

methods.name: createContent
methods.description: Creates content in Amazon Q Connect.

methods.name: createMessageTemplateAttachment
methods.description: Creates an attachment for a message template.

methods.name: createMessageTemplateVersion
methods.description: Creates a new version of a message template.

methods.name: deleteAIAgentVersion
methods.description: Deletes a specific version of an AI agent.

methods.name: deleteAIGuardrailVersion
methods.description: Deletes a specific version of a guardrail.

methods.name: deleteAIPromptVersion
methods.description: Deletes a specific version of an AI prompt.

methods.name: getAIAgent
methods.description: Retrieves details of an AI agent.

methods.name: listAIAgentVersions
methods.description: Lists all versions of an AI agent.

methods.name: listAIPromptVersions
methods.description: Lists all versions of AI prompts.

methods.name: listMessageTemplateVersions
methods.description: Lists all versions of message templates.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: notifyRecommendationsReceived
methods.description: Notifies that recommendations have been received.

methods.name: removeAssistantAIAgent
methods.description: Removes an AI agent from an assistant.

methods.name: removeKnowledgeBaseTemplateUri
methods.description: Removes a URI from the knowledge base.

methods.name: updateKnowledgeBaseTemplateUri
methods.description: Updates the URI in the knowledge base.

methods.name: updateMessageTemplateMetadata
methods.description: Updates metadata of a message template.
